# RC33 public source notes

RC33 deliberately excludes court judgments and blank forms. The additional
benchmark is based on public-source structures from:

- BRPO public contract register (`Kontrahent/nazwa` rows, natural persons,
  companies, law offices, trade-name contractors, contract metadata labels),
- UODO public decision portal (`Decyzja Prezesa UODO nr ...` references),
- UOKiK public decision database (`Decyzja Prezesa UOKiK nr ...` references),
- public procurement/civil-contract templates from Gov.pl and PARP,
- SUDOP-style public-aid search/result structures (`Nazwa beneficjenta`,
  `Nazwa przedsiębiorcy`, NIP, aid reference numbers).

The benchmark cases are synthetic or public-source-derived and contain no client
files. Existing downloaded RC31 public source files are left unchanged.
